import pytest
from company_wiki.automation import narrative_model_runtime as runtime
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_model import NarrativeModelResponse
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_contracts import NarrativeContractError
from company_wiki.automation import narrative_output_language as language
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_paid_response import PaidResponsePin, PaidResponseError
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_model_caller import NarrativeBudgetCallError
from company_wiki.automation.models import HandlerOutcome, HandlerMetrics
from company_wiki.source_catalog import local_prepare_cli
from company_wiki.source_catalog.local_inventory import LocalPrepareLimits, LocalReadBudget, observe_document
from company_wiki.source_catalog.source_reader import SourceReadError
from company_wiki.source_catalog.store import retire_document, restore_document
from support.narrative_model_request_fixture import selection
from unit.test_narrative_reading_transport import with_reading
from unit.test_source_facts import lake


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def no_network(monkeypatch):
    def nope(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("Independent finite review must not call network")
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", nope)
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", nope)


def test_large_scoped_output_keeps_all_exact_qualifications_and_discards_only_bad_basis():
    source = with_reading(selection(3, text_suffix="仅在当地客户验收完成后推进下一阶段；尚未签署商业供货合同。" * 18))
    request = runtime.build_model_request(source, reading_projection_version="reading-model-input/6")
    raw = source.evidence_spans[0].raw_text
    clauses = [{"text": raw, "basis_parts": ["p1"], "modality": "uncertain"} for _ in range(47)]
    payload = {"drafts_by_task": {"t1": clauses + [{"text": raw, "basis_parts": ["absent"], "modality": "uncertain"}]}}
    response = NarrativeModelResponse("synthetic", "configured", request.prompt_version, json.dumps(payload).encode())
    result = runtime.decode_model_draft(response, selected=source, reading_projection_version="reading-model-input/6")
    assert len(result["claims"]) == 47
    assert all(row["text"] == raw and len(row["text"]) > 280 for row in result["claims"])
    assert result["status"] == "needs_review"
    assert all(row["evidence_ids"] == [source.evidence_spans[0].span_id] for row in result["claims"])
    payload["drafts_by_task"]["unknown-task"] = clauses[:1]
    unknown = NarrativeModelResponse("synthetic", "configured", request.prompt_version, json.dumps(payload).encode())
    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="unknown source task"):
        runtime.decode_model_draft(unknown, selected=source, reading_projection_version="reading-model-input/6")


def test_retirement_paging_and_same_discovery_account_are_complete(lake):
    catalog, reader, ref, original = lake
    before = original.read_bytes()
    for _ in range(133):
        retire_document(catalog.store, document_id=ref.document_id, reason="test lifecycle", created_by="synthetic review")
        restore_document(catalog.store, document_id=ref.document_id, reason="same original", created_by="synthetic review")
    budget = LocalReadBudget(LocalPrepareLimits(max_discovery_entries=140))
    observed = observe_document(catalog, ref.document_id, budget=budget)
    assert len(observed["retire_audit"]) == 133
    assert len({row["audit_id"] for row in observed["retire_audit"]}) == 133
    assert budget.discovery_entries >= 135 and budget.bytes_read == 0
    assert reader.open_version(ref).data == original.read_bytes() == before
    with pytest.raises(SourceReadError, match="local_discovery_entry_limit"):
        observe_document(catalog, ref.document_id, budget=budget)
    assert budget.triggered_bound == "max_discovery_entries"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["compatible", "missing-library", "unknown-citation"])
def test_large_language_observation_never_turns_unavailable_into_success(monkeypatch, mode):
    text = "The enterprise delivered the devices under the unchanged customer acceptance conditions. " * 77
    spans = (SimpleNamespace(span_id="raw-a", raw_text=text),)
    claims = tuple(SimpleNamespace(text=text, evidence_ids=("absent" if mode == "unknown-citation" else "raw-a",)) for _ in range(43))
    if mode == "missing-library":
        def missing():
            raise ModuleNotFoundError("synthetic classifier absent")
        monkeypatch.setattr(language, "_get_identifier", missing)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(language, "_get_identifier", lambda: SimpleNamespace(classify=lambda text: ("en", 1.0)))
    result = language.observe_summary_language(claims, evidence_spans=spans)
    assert result.state == {"compatible": "compatible", "missing-library": "unavailable", "unknown-citation": "uncertain"}[mode]
    if mode != "unknown-citation":
        assert result.prose_claims == 43


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["malformed", "wrong-schema"])
def test_large_local_file_never_hides_invalid_request_or_runs_backend(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, bad):
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(local_prepare_cli, "prepare_local_source", lambda *args, **kwargs: calls.append(args))
    path = tmp_path / "input.json"
    path.write_bytes((b'{"schema_version":"wrong"}' if bad == "wrong-schema" else b"not json") + b" " * 280000)
    assert local_prepare_cli.main(["--config", str(tmp_path / "nonexistent.yaml"), "--request", str(path)]) == 1
    result = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
    assert result["status"] == "blocked" and result["reason"] == "invalid_local_prepare_request"
    assert calls == []


def test_long_pin_roundtrip_stays_exact_and_invalid_shape_is_not_relicensed():
    digest = "a" * 64
    kwargs = dict(request_sha256="b" * 64, body_sha256=digest,
        object_key=f"objects/sha256/aa/{digest}.json", byte_size=210000,
        model_id="模型-" * 201, adapter_id="adapter/" * 71, prompt_version="prompt-" * 77,
        http_status=200, duration_ms=2)
    pin = PaidResponsePin(**kwargs)
    assert PaidResponsePin.from_json(pin.to_json()) == pin
    with pytest.raises(PaidResponseError, match="identity"):
        PaidResponsePin(**{**kwargs, "model_id": " " + kwargs["model_id"]})
    with pytest.raises(PaidResponseError, match="digest"):
        PaidResponsePin(**{**kwargs, "body_sha256": "invalid"})


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [True, -1])
def test_content_measurement_retains_type_and_sign_validity(value):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="content byte"):
        NarrativeBudgetCallError("MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED", HandlerOutcome.FAILED_FINAL, HandlerMetrics(), finish_reason="length", content_bytes=value)

def test_retirement_paging_and_same_discovery_account_are_complete(lake):

    catalog, reader, ref, original = lake

    before = original.read_bytes()

    for _ in range(133):

        retire_document(catalog.store, document_id=ref.document_id, reason="test lifecycle", created_by="synthetic review")

        restore_document(catalog.store, document_id=ref.document_id, reason="same original", created_by="synthetic review")

    budget = LocalReadBudget(LocalPrepareLimits(max_discovery_entries=140))

    observed = observe_document(catalog, ref.document_id, budget=budget)

    assert len(observed["retire_audit"]) == 133

    assert len({row["audit_id"] for row in observed["retire_audit"]}) == 133

    assert budget.discovery_entries >= 135 and budget.bytes_read == 0

    assert reader.open_version(ref).data == original.read_bytes() == before

    with pytest.raises(SourceReadError, match="local_discovery_entry_limit"):

        observe_document(catalog, ref.document_id, budget=budget)

    assert budget.triggered_bound == "max_discovery_entries"
